Callout.Name: Aggressive Begging
Callout.Message: Person begging aggressively outside a bank.
Callout.Advisory: Male on foot, following customers, no weapon.

Script.Line: I am not begging. I am asking. There is a difference.
I have been outside this bank two hours and not one person has stopped.
You want me moved on. Moved on to where, exactly?

Lines.Approach: He is following people to the cash machine. Nobody has been hurt, everybody is uncomfortable.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
